description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Hyperion Calculation Manager product of Oracle Hyperion (component: Security).   The supported version that is affected is 11.2.25.0.000. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Hyperion Calculation Manager.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle Hyperion Calculation Manager accessible data and unauthorized ability to cause a partial denial of service (partial DOS) of Oracle Hyperion Calculation Manager. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.1 (Confidentiality and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:L).
